input.question: Which key in your profile is the one your game uses for crouch? I couldn't find a row literally labeled "crouch", so I want to bind the right one.

options.label: Row 79: kb_left_control (Ctrl) — currently triggered by a triple sip
Row 84: kb_c (C key) — currently triggered by a left sip
Row 82: kb_z (Z key) — currently triggered by a soft right puff
